title: In Silico Identification of Therapeutic Targets and Novel Drug Candidates for Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors.
authors: Wei, Min; Fan, Jianfeng; Peng, Renjun; Ding, Xiping; Xi, Jian; Huang, He
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组差异表达和分子对接筛选MPNST药物靶点Twist1，虽涉及转录因子和分子对接，但核心是疾病药物发现而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors (MPNSTs) are an aggressive form of sarcomas with a poor prognosis and limited treatment options. Therefore, new therapeutic targets are urgently needed to identify novel drugs. METHODS: Based on the Gene Expression Omnibus database, an integrated analysis was performed to identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in MPNSTs compared to neurofibromas (NFs). Then functional enrichment analyses, protein-protein interaction (PPI) network construction, and hub gene selection were conducted. We explored DEG-guided repurposable drugs to treat MPNST based on the Library of Integrated Network-Based Cellular Signatures (LINCS) database. Furthermore, the binding affinity between predicted drug candidates and the MPNST-associated hub gene was calculated using molecular docking. RESULTS: We identified 89 DEGs in common with all three MPNSTs datasets. In the PPI networks, twist family bHLH transcription factor 1 (Twist1) with higher node degrees was further evaluated as a therapeutic target. Cytochalasin-d, cabozantinib, everolimus, refametinib, and BGT-226 were extracted from the LINCS database, which showed lower normalized connectivity scores (-1.88, -1.81, -1.78, -1.76, and -1.72, respectively) and was considered as drug candidates. In addition, the results of molecular docking between the five drugs and Twist1 showed a binding affinity of -6.61, -7.03, -7.73, -3.94, and -7.07 kcal/mol, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Overall, our results describe the importance of Twist1 in MPNST pathogenesis. Everolimus was also found to be a potential therapeutic drug for MPNSTs.
abstract_zh: 背景：恶性外周神经鞘瘤（MPNSTs）是一种侵袭性肉瘤，预后差且治疗选择有限。因此，迫切需要识别新的治疗靶点以发现新药物。方法：基于基因表达综合数据库，进行整合分析以识别MPNSTs与神经纤维瘤（NFs）相比的差异表达基因（DEGs）。随后进行了功能富集分析、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络构建及核心基因筛选。我们基于网络基础细胞特征综合库（LINCS）数据库探索了DEG引导的可再利用药物治疗MPNST。此外，利用分子对接计算了预测候选药物与MPNST相关核心基因之间的结合亲和力。结果：我们在所有三个MPNST数据集中共同识别出89个DEGs。在PPI网络中，具有较高节点度的twist家族bHLH转录因子1（Twist1）被进一步评估为治疗靶点。从LINCS数据库中提取了细胞松弛素-d、卡博替尼、依维莫司、瑞法替尼和BGT-226，它们显示出较低的归一化连接分数（分别为-1.88、-1.81、-1.78、-1.76和-1.72），并被视为候选药物。此外，五种药物与Twist1之间的分子对接结果显示结合亲和力分别为-6.61、-7.03、-7.73、-3.94和-7.07 kcal/mol。结论：总体而言，我们的结果描述了Twist1在MPNST发病机制中的重要性。同时发现依维莫司可能是治疗MPNST的潜在药物。
